# Product names as listed in the NVD CPE dictionary, written down independently
# of techs.yaml. A CPE in the shipped techs.yaml that is not on this list fails CI,
# because a wrong name silently hides real advisories. Add a name here only after
# checking it in the dictionary (cvewatch doctor -online does that).
# tech vendor:product
php php:php
nodejs nodejs:node.js
nextjs vercel:next.js
gitlab gitlab:gitlab
elasticsearch elastic:elasticsearch
magento magento:magento
magento adobe:commerce
nginx nginx:nginx
redis redis:redis
go golang:go
python python:python
